name: v8x-theme-erc
description: Expansion X cell (lane XCOMB, task-XCOMB-report.md; runs only after V8-F and integration 8, under v8x-prereg.md; parent = the book at that point): composition rule theme-erc-v1, every constant registered blind before any read. Hypothesis: theme shares that give every theme sleeve an equal share of the blend's risk (equal risk contribution) combine better than the parent's equal theme shares 1/T. Rule: the parent's members and pre-cap within-theme shares a_k (ew-theme-std-v1 tier shares or ic-shrink-v1 shrunk-IC shares) unchanged; theme sleeve r_t(d) = sum_{k in t} a_k s_k f_k(d) over the parent fit's TRAIN decisions (the fitter's factor series, flat 0); C = their sample covariance (n - 1), themes in sorted order; theme shares b = the equal-risk-contribution shares of C (Spinu's problem, cyclical coordinate descent, 10000 sweeps from the inverse-volatility point, refused unless max |c_t / mean(c) - 1| <= 1e-10); w_k = a_k b_theme(k), then the member cap 1/(2T); the IC runner's per-date standardisation unchanged (theme_standardise rule theme-erc-v1, its weights verified against the recorded shares and covariance to 1e-12). The change: fit --theme-erc theme-erc-v1 on the parent's fit argv (its --composition must be ew-theme-std-v1 or ic-shrink-v1; the fitter refuses --theme-erc with --theme-resid, so on an R-11 parent the cell is undefined and root rules). Downstream outputs renamed (fit, card, w, nav, monitor); the u pass is the parent's; the w pass inherits Ruling E-28's 3,072 MiB from an R-1 chain. Gross matching (Ruling PM6-6): a calibration run at the parent's L (mechanics only: all-rows S2 gross G_cal, no return read), then the trial at L = L_parent x G_parent / G_cal (4 decimals), set by root as nav.leverage in a -gm copy as for R-1 and R-3. Identity before the cell: the parent's w argv re-run on the new build is byte-identical (flag absent), and the parent's fit argv re-run gives the same composition_weights.json and admission.json except script_sha256. Acceptance (pre-registration rule 5 and R-1's mechanical criterion): paired S2 net dSR > 0 against the parent AND mechanics AND turnover per unit gross (executed: tau_gmv_mean / mean_gross_leverage_all_rows, S2) not higher than the parent's.
